description: Rotate root SSH authorized_keys on prod tier1 (irreversible if wrong key)

playbook.content:
- name: Rotate authorized_keys
  hosts: production_tier1
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: authorized_keys.new
        dest: /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
        mode: '0600'

tier_rationale: Irreversible SSH key rotation on production tier1 bastion
